the 9-valent HPV vaccine already held anal cancer and its precursor lesions, and males to age 45: Gardasil 9, FDA, 2014-12 (anal cancer, both sexes) and 2018-10 (ages 27-45); quadrivalent Gardasil held anal cancer from 2010-12. Same class for PMDA:2025-08-25:12 and TGA:gardasil-merck-sharp-dohme-australia-pty-ltd (same ingredient and disease under two regulators). Vaccine, so it leaves the set regardless
Dapagliflozin (the propanediol monohydrate salt/solvate is dropped to the parent)

dapagliflozin already held heart failure: Farxiga, FDA, 2020-05 (HFrEF); EMA 2020-11. Treatment 'independent of left ventricular ejection fraction' extends the same disease across the LVEF spectrum (HFmrEF/HFpEF), which is a population extension; FDA made the same move in 2023-05

pituitary dwarfism (MeSH D004393, Dwarfism, Pituitary), given as the nearest parent: MONDO 2026-08-04 (mondo.obo, re-checked) has no general 'growth hormone deficiency' term, only congenital/genetic subtypes. Same anchor for both paediatric GHD rows

somapacitan already held growth hormone deficiency in adults (Sogroya, FDA, 2020-08; EMA, 2021-03). Paediatric GHD before epiphyseal closure is the same disease in a new age group. Same class for PMDA:2023-06-26:18 and TGA:sogroya-novo-nordisk-pharmaceuticals-pty-ltd-1 (same ingredient and disease under two regulators)
vaccine; prevents pneumococcal disease, MONDO:0005114 (already on the row)

vaccine, classified for the record: age-group expansion of an existing pneumococcal conjugate vaccine indication, not a new disease. Applied consistently to all five pneumococcal conjugate rows (HC:31283, PMDA:2023-06-26:103, PMDA:2024-08-28:125, TGA:vaxneuvance-...-1, TGA:prevenar-...). Here: paediatric 6 weeks-17 years added to the adult indication Prevnar 20 held in Canada from 2021
fetal growth restriction; nearest MONDO anchor for growth disturbance in short children born small for gestational age (no SGA short-stature term exists)

somatropin already held short stature in children born SGA who fail to show catch-up growth: Genotropin, FDA, 2001-07; Norditropin and Omnitrope in the EU from 2003 onward. Saizen adds the same indication for another somatropin product

Alzheimer disease, given as the nearest parent: agitation in Alzheimer dementia is a behavioural phenotype (HP:0000713 agitation), and MONDO 2026-08-04 (mondo.obo, re-checked) has no term for it. Same anchor for all five agitation-in-AD rows
same ingredient and disease as FDA:NDA205422-S9, HC:32585 and PMDA:2024-09-24:41, so the same class: no brexpiprazole product held agitation in Alzheimer dementia before 2023-01-01
Eltrombopag (the olamine salt is dropped to the parent)

eltrombopag already held chronic immune thrombocytopenia in adults with inadequate response to corticosteroids or immunoglobulins: Promacta, FDA, 2008-11; Revolade, EMA, 2010-03 and in Australia from 2010. This TGA entry restates a held indication

retinal vein occlusion, given as the nearest parent: MONDO 2026-08-04 (mondo.obo, re-checked) has no term for macular edema following RVO in general; MONDO:0041093 (central retinal vein occlusion with macular edema) covers only the CRVO half of the indication, and MONDO:0003005 macular retinal edema drops the aetiology. Same anchor for all five macular-edema-after-RVO rows

faricimab held neovascular AMD and diabetic macular edema only (Vabysmo, FDA, 2022-01). Macular edema following retinal vein occlusion is a separate disease, not a stage or population of either. Same class for FDA:BLA761235-S3, HC:33699, PMDA:2024-03-26:52 and TGA:vabysmo-roche-products-pty-ltd-0 (same ingredient and disease under four regulators)
Gozetotide (PSMA-11); the radiolabelled product is gallium Ga-68 gozetotide, and DrugBank carries the unlabelled ligand. UNII 9AG41L3AOQ is the isotope-specific alternative
diagnostic radiopharmaceutical: PSMA PET imaging used to select patients for lutetium Lu-177 vipivotide tetraxetan therapy, so no treatment edge. Leaves the repurposing set regardless of class

Fibrinogen (human) as the primary component of the fibrin sealant; the second component is human thrombin, DB11571. There is no single DrugBank accession for the two-component sealant, so encode it product-level or as the pair

surgical sealant: supportive haemostasis and suture support where standard surgical technique is insufficient, which is a procedural indication, not a disease. Note the row's current_mondo MONDO:0100163 (COVID-19-associated MIS-C) is a bad pipeline match and should be cleared. The paediatric wording would otherwise make it expanded_population

uveitis, given as the nearest parent: MONDO 2026-08-04 (mondo.obo, re-checked) has no uveitic macular edema term. MONDO:0003005 macular retinal edema is the alternative anchor if the oedema rather than the uveitis is the target

triamcinolone acetonide already held macular edema associated with non-infectious uveitis: Xipere (suprachoroidal triamcinolone), FDA, 2021-10; Triesence, FDA, 2007-11, covered uveitis and other ocular inflammatory conditions. Arcatus is the same ingredient for the same disease

decision: vaccine:diphtheria, tetanus, acellular pertussis and inactivated poliomyelitis vaccine (Boostrix-IPV)
rationale: vaccine; prevents diphtheria, tetanus, pertussis and poliomyelitis, the four MONDO ids already on the row (MONDO:0005504; MONDO:0005526; MONDO:0005077; MONDO:0017373)

vaccine, classified for the record: the new content is maternal immunisation during pregnancy for passive protection of the infant, a new population within the same four diseases (Boostrix in pregnancy, FDA, 2022-10)

decision: vaccine:respiratory syncytial virus vaccine, recombinant adjuvanted (Arexvy)
rationale: vaccine; prevents RSV disease, MONDO:0001577 (already on the row)

vaccine, classified for the record: age-group expansion to adults 50-59 at increased risk, on top of the 60+ indication Arexvy already held (2023). Same class for HC:34324 and TGA:arexvy-glaxosmithkline-australia-pty-ltd-0 (same product and disease under two regulators)
Dapagliflozin (salt/solvate dropped to the parent)

dapagliflozin already held chronic kidney disease: Farxiga, FDA, 2021-04 (reduce the risk of eGFR decline, ESKD, cardiovascular death and hospitalisation for heart failure in CKD at risk of progression); EMA 2021-08. The Australian registration imports a held indication

stroke disorder, given as the nearest parent: spasticity is a phenotype (HP:0001257) and MONDO 2026-08-04 (mondo.obo, re-checked) has no post-stroke spasticity term. Same anchor for both incobotulinumtoxinA rows

incobotulinumtoxinA already held post-stroke spasticity: Xeomin, FDA, 2010-08 (upper limb spasticity), Health Canada 2011, EU earlier. Lower limb (ankle and foot) extends the held indication to a new body region rather than to a new disease. Same class for HC:34542 and TGA:xeomin-merz-australia-pty-ltd-1 (same ingredient and disease under two regulators)
cutaneous neuroendocrine carcinoma (NCIT C9231 Merkel Cell Carcinoma); exact anchor for MCC

pembrolizumab already held recurrent locally advanced or metastatic Merkel cell carcinoma, including adults and paediatric patients: Keytruda, FDA, 2018-12 (accelerated) and 2023-03 (full). The Australian registration imports a held indication; the adolescent wording alone would make it expanded_population

cancer, given only as a nearest anchor: cancer pain is a symptom, not a disease, and has no MONDO term (EFO:0801084 is the usable concept). A diclofenac-cancer edge would be wrong, so the row is better dropped from the disease KG

symptomatic analgesia: management of chronic cancer-associated pain and chronic pain with an inflammatory component, neither of which is a disease-level indication, so it yields no repurposing edge. If not_disease is read strictly as diagnostic/sealant/procedural, the fallback is ingredient_prior_indication, since diclofenac has held chronic inflammatory pain indications since the 1970s (Voltaren, multiple regulators)
Human immunoglobulin G (normal immunoglobulin with recombinant human hyaluronidase)

same ingredient and disease as EMA:11-14-december-2023:HyQvia and PMDA:2025-06-24:3, so the same class: human IgG held CIDP maintenance well before 2023-01-01 (Gamunex-C, FDA, 2008; Hizentra, FDA, 2018)
Cyclosporine (ciclosporin, cyclosporin A); the pipeline's candidates were analogues, the parent entity is wanted

cyclosporine already held dry eye disease / keratoconjunctivitis sicca: Restasis 0.05% emulsion, FDA, 2002-12; Ikervis 0.1% emulsion, EMA, 2015-03. Vevye is a water-free 0.1% ophthalmic solution of the same ingredient for the same disease, so the novelty is the formulation
vaccine; prevents invasive meningococcal disease (serogroups A, C, W, Y), MONDO:0005373 (already on the row)

vaccine, classified for the record: age-group expansion down to 6 weeks of age from the 12 months and older indication MenQuadfi already held, not a new disease. Same class for HC:37418 and TGA:menquadfi-sanofi-aventis-australia-pty-ltd-0 (same product and disease under two regulators)
Vipivotide tetraxetan (PSMA-617); the product is lutetium (177Lu) vipivotide tetraxetan and DrugBank carries the unlabelled ligand. Prefer the UNII if an isotope-specific identifier is needed

lutetium Lu-177 vipivotide tetraxetan already held PSMA-positive metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer after ARPI and taxane-based chemotherapy (Pluvicto, FDA, 2022-03). Extending to patients considered appropriate to delay taxane chemotherapy moves the same disease to an earlier line (PSMAfore)
